annotations.title: Download several clips as one zip

description:
Use this when the user wants several clips in one file: "download all my clips", "zip the batch", "give me
        every clip from that stream", "send me the whole set". Returns download_url, a private link to one zip with
        each clip's video plus captions.txt and clips.csv (title, caption and hashtags per file). The link works for
        five minutes (call again for a fresh one; keep it private).
        clip_ids: clips from list_clips, up to 100. project_id: from list_projects, every clip made from that video.
        Give one of them, or neither for the newest batch of clips. Photos are left out.
        Not for: one clip (get_download_link), another shape or quality (export_clip) or a saved photo
        (get_download_link). Free: no Horizon Units; it only makes a short-lived link and changes nothing.
name: download_all_clips
title: Download several clips as one zip
